tagline: You can now use the AI Functions Asynchronous API to run ai parse document, ai extract, or ai classify asynchronously on up to 50,000 requests from a JSONL file in a Unity Catalog volume.
what_it_does: You can now use the AI Functions Asynchronous API to run ai parse document, ai extract, or ai classify asynchronously on up to 50,000 requests from a JSONL file in a Unity Catalog volume. The batch writes one result for each request to a file in a volume. Workspace admins can turn on the AI Functions Asynchronous API preview from the Previews page.
why_it_matters: For workspaces with the Enhanced Security and Compliance add on, + See regional support for ai classify for the appropriate compliance standard.
